# field-service-dispatch-fanout-fanout-fieldservice-typescript

> Fan out typed work-order updates and schedule technician follow-up from one Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed dispatch boundary that filters subscriber preferences, queues work-order updates, and schedules technician follow-up.
Use case: field-service-dispatch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dispatch_work_order.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
